about_the_game:
Enjoy the cuteness of cats in the cat café.

Look for the cute cats’ mischievous tricks (anomalies).

The cat-eared maid will give you hints.

We tried to create the purr-fect cat game for streaming

Dear Streamer,

You can stream from this unique cat cafe setting.

Overflowing with cuteness — it's almost impossible to keep streaming!

Warning: Vocabulary meltdown incoming.

Create heartwarming interactions between the streamer and the cats.

Watch your audience laugh as the cats drive you wild.

Selfish cats, flustered streamers, happy viewers! Everyone wins!

Game Streaming and Video Posting Guidelines

You are free to stream or upload videos of this game.

Advertising and monetization of your streams/videos are completely acceptable.

Both individuals and corporations are welcome to stream and post gameplay content.

No permission from the author is required for any game streaming or video posting.

There are no restrictions on streaming or showing the game's ending.

Including the game title and sales link in your video is not required, but it would be a big help for promotion!

Please note: The developer takes no responsibility for any trouble or damages caused by streaming or posting videos of this game.

Easy for Anyone to Play

A lightweight 3D game that runs on a standard laptop.

It works even on computers without a graphics card.

The controls are standard FPS.

Gamepads are also supported.

The difficulty can be set to Easy, Normal, or Hard,

so even beginners or those who aren’t confident with games can enjoy playing without stress.

Story

You’re in trouble.

You can’t find the exit of the café.

You're stuck in the cat cafe, and a cat-eared maid approaches you.

"Ah… are you trying to get out of here too?

Even if you leave through the exit, you end up back at the entrance, right?

I’ll share the ‘rules for escaping’ that the cats taught me.

‘If something feels meow-strange, turn back.

If it doesn’t feel meow-strange, keep going forward.

And if you fix an anomaly, go forward too.’

A kind cat taught me those rules, but honestly… they’re too tricky for me.

So I want you to find the exit… meow."

Playtime

15 minutes to 60 minutes

Game Content

What is an anomyeowly?

Sometimes strange things happen in this place.

For example... the cat is wearing a strange hat, or the cat suddenly breaks a plate...

The 10 cats you just saw increase to 11...

A variety of anomalies await you, from hilarious cat pranks to shocking horror traps.

If you encounter such an unusual "anomaly," turn back.

But if there is no "anomaly," just keep going forward.

And if you fix an anomary, you can move forward.

It seems the Anomaly Mode won't be deactivated unless the 10 cats are satisfied.

It seems that the cats' anger is causing the anomalies.

Now it's up to you to uncover the anomalies in this looping cat café, with the cat-eared maid.

short_description: The cat café is supposed to be a blissful feline paradise... but something feels off. Mischievous cats cause all kinds of anomalies, throwing the shop into chaos. Even the pretty cat-eared maid is completely at a loss, meowing for help.
